ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (estimated 85-90%) with localized high-intensity white/grey mottling concentrated on trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light-intensity mottling clusters are mapped along the distal trailing edges of both lobes; the central and proximal fluke surfaces are characterized by contiguous low-intensity dark pixel blocks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated 50-degree interior angle dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical curvature; the left lobe displays a broad convex sweep while the right lobe shows a more slender, acute concave sweep toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast yellowish/white circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical light-intensity linear tracks visible against the dark pigment on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion and apparent tissue loss at the distal tip of the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small circular dark spot (ocellus) surrounded by a lighter ring located near the terminal edge of the right lobe tip.
